definition: **Acro-osteolysis（指/趾端骨溶解）常見於：scleroderma、psoriatic arthritis、hyperparathyroidism、thermal injury、PVC exposure、leprosy 等。NF1 不是典型原因。**
keyPoints: **Psoriatic arthritis**：DIP 關節 pencil-in-cup，可合併 tuft erosion
**不典型**：Neurofibromatosis type 1（NF1 主要造成長骨 bowing、pseudarthrosis、sphenoid dysplasia，非 acro-osteolysis）
name: Acro-osteolysis Differential Diagnosis
